resources.string: Open Flow uses Accessibility only to detect focused text fields and insert your on-device speech-to-text. It does not replace your keyboard. Speak as long as you want while the bubble is listening — sessions auto-restart after OS pauses. No cloud. No analytics. Password fields skipped.
Enable Open Flow in Accessibility for the floating bubble. Keep your normal keyboard.
Microphone is required to dictate and record.
No recordings yet. Tap demo session.
No INTERNET permission. Voice stays on device by default.
Speak as long as you want. OS STT pauses every few seconds of silence — we auto-restart so dictation continues until you tap the bubble again.
